members.name: BuildHumanoid
members.signature: public static Avatar BuildHumanoid(Skeleton skeleton, HumanDescription description)

docs.summary: Builds a humanoid avatar from an explicit mapping. The description is copied. Throws `ArgumentException` if a required bone is missing, a bone index is outside the skeleton, or two humanoid bones share a skeleton bone.

members.name: TryBuildHumanoid
members.signature: public static bool TryBuildHumanoid(Skeleton skeleton, out Avatar? avatar)

docs.summary: Tries to build a humanoid avatar by auto-mapping the skeleton. Returns false (and a null avatar) if the skeleton is not recognised as humanoid.
A humanoid avatar if [`HumanoidAutoMapper`](#api~Prowl.Motion.HumanoidAutoMapper) succeeds, otherwise a generic one.
